hook: Cold lowers IL-1β and flips brown fat cells to a high-heat state, and aged fat stays stuck in the low state
hook_turn: aged fat stays stuck in the low state
summary: IL-1β from immune cells keeps some brown fat cells at low UCP1 through a glucocorticoid pathway. Cold reduces IL-1β, switching these cells to high heat output, but old mice have too much IL-1β. Blocking the glucocorticoid receptor restored heat production in aged mice. Mouse work only.
title: Bistable regulation of adipocyte heterogeneity governs thermogenesis.
